title: Implement _eval_derivative_n_times for cos class
description: Add the _eval_derivative_n_times method to the cos class in the trigonometric.py file. The method signature should be _eval_derivative_n_times(self, s, n) where s is the symbol and n is the number of derivatives. When the argument equals the symbol s, return cos(arg + n*pi/2). Handle the case where n is an integer or symbolic. Return None if the derivative cannot be computed symbolically.
expected_output: The cos class with the new _eval_derivative_n_times method implementation that computes the n-th derivative using the formula cos(arg + n*pi/2).
